l0.text: The end-of-term festival. The greenhouse lights glow through the glass, warm against the cold night.

l1.speaker: python
l1.text: I don't need curly braces to tell you where we stand. It's always been you, {player}, at this exact level.

l2.speaker: python
l2.text: So... would you co-author my senior research project with me? I already wrote your name on the title page. In pencil. Mostly.

l3.speaker: narrator
l3.text: Epilogue: the two of you in the greenhouse, and a small plant on the shelf labeled with your name.
